business: Mitra, an AI growth coach for Indian regional-language YouTube creators
by_segment: Growing part-time creator (10K-100K subs, earns some AdSense or brand deals)
Small hobby-to-serious creator (1K-10K subs, not monetised or just monetised), student or day job
Full-time regional creator (100K-500K subs, YouTube is main income, may have an editor)
by_behaviour: Already pays for vidIQ or TubeBuddy
why_not: I'm a Hindi creator and I already get growth tips free from the big channels I watch at night. Handing my YouTube login to an app I've never heard of, just to get a chatbot's take on my own numbers, doesn't feel worth it when I can check the analytics myself.

Tools don't grow channels, consistency and luck do. I already check YouTube Studio every morning for free, and I'd rather copy what the Hindi guys in my feed say than pay a bot to tell me what my own numbers already show.
I already pay for vidIQ or TubeBuddy and only use half of it, so I don't need another tool. Honestly my videos do better when I post consistently, not when I buy another dashboard.

YouTube Studio already tells me which videos beat my usual views, and I can see my own comments. Mitra sounds like the same data with a Monday email on top, and I live in WhatsApp, not my inbox. I need to see it find something I couldn't have seen in Studio before I pay anything.

I tried vidIQ and it didn't help, and I've never paid for a creator tool. Ten free credits a month is enough to poke at it, but I'm not paying until it shows me something YouTube Studio doesn't already show me.

I've never paid for a creator tool. vidIQ, TubeBuddy and YouTube Studio already give me numbers for free, and ChatGPT tells me what to post. I don't have time to read another dashboard, and a monthly report by email is one more thing I'll skip.

I'm not paying ₹99 a month for something when my channel earns nothing yet. Even if the analytics are useful, I don't know yet whether they'd turn into views, and I'd rather spend that money on editing help.
My channel earns nothing yet, so paying ₹99 a month for an AI coach feels like throwing money away. I already open YouTube Studio every morning and can see my own numbers there for free.
